payload.title: Security hardening after the M3 review (#16)
payload.objective: Close the seven gaps the independent security review of M3 found before more members or a wider network reach the instance.
successCriteria: Horizon is open to instance operators only
The web port binds to loopback by default
Only owners connect and disconnect channels
A workspace always keeps an owner and setup stays closed
The host is checked against APP_URL
